items.description: Host may terminate the Agreement if the voluntary power-off period runs past the stated length.
items.span_text: If the Voluntary Power-off Period exceeds 30 consecutive days, Host may terminate this Agreement.
items.trigger: If the Voluntary Power-off Period exceeds 30 consecutive days

items.description: Host credits curtailment revenue earned from the CSP against the Client's monthly invoice in the month Host receives it.
items.span_text: Revenue earned from the CSP from Client electing to curtail will be applied as a credit to the monthly invoice in the month that Host receives the Curtailment Program Revenue

items.description: Any Client share of curtailment revenue above a month's invoice is carried forward as a credit to later months.
items.span_text: Client’s share of that excess amount shall be carried over as a credit to subsequent month(s).
items.trigger: If Client Curtailment Program Revenue exceeds the total amount of the invoice for any individual month

items.description: When Host does not follow a power-off or curtailment instruction, it must give Client written notice of the reasons.
items.span_text: In such cases, Host shall provide written notice to Client specifying the reason(s) it has not complied with such instruction

items.description: Client must not give an instruction with a strike price at or below the Minimum Strike Price unless the parties agree otherwise in writing.
items.span_text: Client shall not, as part of providing Host an instruction under this Article 5, provide a strike price equal to or less than the Minimum Strike Price, unless otherwise agreed by the parties in writing.

items.description: Host must provide sufficient server rooms, racks, power, network and related facilities for the Colocation Servers from the Initial Date until termination.
items.span_text: No later than the Initial Date and at all times up to and until the termination of this Agreement, Host shall provide Client with sufficient server rooms or containers, server positions, racks, power load and facilities, broadband network and network facilities

items.description: If Host does not fix an insufficient power load within the stated period after Client's notice, Client may proportionately reduce the Colocation Quantity.
items.span_text: If Host fails to remedy the issue within 14 days, Client shall be entitled to proportionately reduce the Colocation Quantity of the Colocation Servers at its sole discretion
items.trigger: If Host fails to remedy the issue within 14 days

items.description: Sufficient forklifts, lift trucks and related equipment must be available for timely racking and de-racking of the Colocation Servers.
items.span_text: There shall be sufficient forklifts, lift trucks and other related machinery and equipment to provide timely racking and de-racking services for the Colocation Servers.

items.description: Host must give Client written notice of curtailment events such as force majeure, maintenance outages or hazardous conditions.
items.span_text: Host agrees to provide written notice to Client of any of the foregoing events, as specified in this Agreement.

items.description: Host must give Client written notice of any service suspension within a reasonable time, endeavoring to do so within 24 hours.
items.span_text: Host shall provide written notice of any suspension of Service to Client within a reasonable time, but shall endeavor to provide such notice within 24 hours of such suspension.

items.description: Host must provide exclusive, physically separated containers or server rooms for the Colocation Servers.
items.span_text: Host shall provide exclusive containers or server room(s) for the operation of the Colocation Servers, which shall be physically separated from containers or server rooms at the Data Center Facility for use by other customers of Host.

items.description: Host must maintain the standard colocation environment according to the Service Order and Information Memorandum.
items.span_text: Host shall maintain the standard Colocation environment for the Colocation Servers in accordance with the conditions set forth in the applicable Service Order and the Information Memorandum.

items.description: The Server Provider must use standard industry efforts to keep the Data Center Facility and Colocation Servers safe and secure, including maintaining Host Equipment to a reasonable standard.
items.span_text: Server Provider shall take standard industry efforts to ensure safety and security of the Data Center Facility and the Colocation Servers

items.description: Host must keep the facility operation, its personnel and the Services compliant with Applicable Laws and hold all required approvals and permits.
items.span_text: Host shall ensure that the operation of the Data Center Facility, the individuals of Host and provision of Services is at all times in compliance with Applicable Laws

items.description: Host must organize safety training and drills for Client personnel at least as often as for its own personnel.
items.span_text: Host shall organize necessary safety training and safety drills for Client Personal at least as regularly as its own personnel.
